claimText: As determined by the appropriate ATS authority as appropriate: when special electronic or other aids enable the pilot-in-command of an aircraft to determine accurately the aircraft’s position and when adequate communication facilities exist for that position to be transmitted without delay to the appropriate air traffic control unit;
rationale: Defines reduction circumstance based on pilot-determined position and adequate communication facilities.
